lines.text: The descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already there.
After Joseph and his generation died, the Israelites multiplied, and a new king who did not know Joseph came to power.
Egypt appointed taskmasters over the Israelites, who built Nineveh and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
The king told the Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah to kill the baby daughters, but they feared God and let the boys live.
God was good to the midwives and gave them families, and Pharaoh commanded that every Hebrew son be thrown into the Nile.
